name: dnsmon Self-Hosted DNS Propagation and Change Monitor
free_limit: Apache-2.0 licensed self-hosted DNS propagation checker and monitoring dashboard; checks DNS records across public resolvers, supports delegation traces, alerting and a local web UI, without a vendor software subscription or per-query license quota.
watch_out: Not a free hosted DNS service. Scheduled monitor execution is not yet implemented (manual/API-triggered checks only). Requires user-operated compute/network; DNS resolver limits, hosting, domains and third-party alert transports may incur costs. The upstream README warns that UI authentication is disabled by default and notification credentials are stored as plaintext; secure any public deployment.
